value.rationale: The separation parameter is intrinsic to the definition and the value one is the universal extremum. Determining the exact onset of saturation is a natural structural boundary, and the result distinguishes the entire subcritical regime from the extremal one rather than evaluating an arbitrary isolated parameter.
